## PlateLight

A touchscreen well-plate illuminator for guiding pipetting by hand -- lights up the target well so you can find it without squinting at a plate map. Runs entirely in the browser, fullscreen, on a tablet propped next to the plate.

[Open PlateLight](platelight.html){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}
